articles.summary: After two or more losses, standard testing often comes back “normal.” Here is the genetic workup that standard panels can miss — and what recent research can and cannot promise.
articles.title: Recurrent Pregnancy Loss: The Genetic Workup Beyond a Karyotype

articles.summary: A single euploid loss usually isn't a pattern. Here is what a normal PGT-A result can and cannot explain — and when it is worth looking deeper.
articles.title: When a Euploid Embryo Doesn't Make It
